label: Front page
description: A front page that builds itself from tags. You set the lead story and a list of bands; each band pulls the latest posts carrying one tag, so publishing a post files it on the front page automatically.

fields.label: Pull from tag
fields.description: The newest post carrying this tag becomes the lead, so you promote a story by tagging it. Type the tag the way you wrote it on the post — Business, The Economy, Asia Pacific. Capitals and spaces do not matter. Not sure what you have used? Open a Section front with no tag set: the filter chips across the top list every tag on the site. Leave empty to write the lead by hand below.

fields.label: Image
fields.description: Leave empty to use the post's featured image. Set one here to override it on the front page only.

fields.label: Caption
fields.description: Leave empty to use the caption on the post's featured image.

fields.label: Kicker
fields.description: Leave empty to use the post's kicker, or its first tag.

fields.label: Headline
fields.description: Ignored when a tag is set.

fields.label: Byline
fields.description: Leave empty to use the post's byline.

fields.label: Links to
fields.description: Ignored when a tag is set.

page_options.label: Bands
page_options.description: Each band is one tag. Add a band, name the tag, and every post you file under it turns up here in date order.

fields.label: Band title
fields.description: Leave empty for an unlabelled band, the way a real front page runs.

fields.label: Tag
fields.description: Type the tag the way you wrote it on the post — Business, The Economy, Asia Pacific. Capitals and spaces do not matter. Not sure what you have used? Open a Section front with no tag set: the filter chips across the top list every tag on the site. Leave empty to show the latest posts regardless of tag.

fields.label: 'More' links to
fields.description: Optional path to the section front, e.g. /business.

fields.label: Show pictures
fields.description: Print each story's featured image. Grid layouts only; the ledger and opinion strip stay text.

page_options.label: Show the masthead and section rail
